lines: It's just a monologue, don't ask me about embarrassing things.
It's about you, but I won't say what comes after.
A frustrating feeling like mismatched buttons.
It stays unresolved, and I'm trying to make it harder.
The feelings I want to convey are still here today.
Just before they become words, they get tangled in conversion errors.
If I swallow them with a sigh, they turn bitter...
I find myself searching at random moments.
I'm searching for your smile.
In my subconscious, I can't yet explain the reason.
When I'm alone, I end up missing you.
No matter who I'm with, I still miss you.
Just one word—hey, why?
I can't say those words, I can't say this feeling, ah.
I wish you'd notice sooner.
Like a puzzle with a thousand pieces, the choices...
My imagination keeps hindering my judgment.
The feelings I can't grasp are still here today.
Showing an unlovable face, filled with self‑hate and regret.
I'm far from being able to spit out the 'I'm sorry' I've been holding.
If you listen closely, you can hear it.
Only your voice comes through.
In the crowd I pretend not to notice.
But when you're beside me, I feel happy.
When you're far away, I feel lonely.
It's simple, yet why...
I can't say those words, I can't say this feeling, ah.
I want to be more honest.
The sky looks like it's about to burst into tears...
A single raindrop on my cheek...
I hide my unstable heart under an umbrella.
I hide everything in my monologue.
Actually, I've always thought of you, ah.
I find myself searching at random moments.
I'm searching for your smile.
In my subconscious, I can't yet explain the reason.
When I'm alone, I end up missing you.
No matter who I'm with, I still miss you.
Just one word—hey, why?
I can't say those words, I can't say this feeling, ah.
I wish you'd notice sooner.
